detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.summary: Consensus reliability is contingent upon the epistemic independence of constituent evidence sources. When external expert consensus exhibits correlated error structures, independent analysis provides a superior epistemic foundation.
detail.reason: Revising the judgment and consensus notebook to integrate governance mechanics and multi-source evidence under Policy 3 standards.

detail.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
detail.summary: Accountability is enforced via strict bifurcation of inquiry (model-driven) and governance (state-committed). This design prevents models from subverting the research record by ensuring that only valid, rule-compliant transitions are committed to durable history.
detail.reason: Revision of the architecture synthesis notebook to integrate evidence from the research code boundary and clarify the distinction between proposal and governance.
